The Analytical Quality and Assurance function owns and maintains this playbook. It decides what changes after publication.

## Who this playbook is for

This playbook is for NHSBSA staff who commission, produce or assure analysis. It is published
openly, so anyone can read how NHSBSA expects its analysis to be planned, checked and signed off.

Anyone can open links to the published standards and to NHSBSA's published policies. You need an
NHSBSA account to open links to NHSBSA's SharePoint site, such as the templates and the Analytical
Assurance Decision Tool.

NHSBSA keeps a public register of its Business Critical analyses and reports on them each year.
See [the public register and annual reporting](guidance/09-resources/r16-what-makes-work-business-critical.qmd#the-public-register-and-annual-reporting).

## Suggesting a change

Send a change as a pull request. Follow [How to contribute](CONTRIBUTE.md).

To raise anything other than a change to the text, contact the Analytical Quality and Assurance function. [Who to ask](guidance/09-resources/r3-who-to-ask.qmd) lists who to contact for everything else.
